source_snapshot.items: UMC Uncorrectable Address Or Command Parity Single Shot
source_snapshot.procedure: Inject one d0/b0/s4/t4/m1 fatal UMC parity fault, recover as required, decode OOB CPER and reconcile surviving in-band -C.
source_snapshot.criteria: Injection success; mapped OAM, UMC, ext4 AddressCommandParityErr and Uncorrected system fatal severity; in-band agrees where available.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL generic review omits exact fatal/single-shot/recovery semantics.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; mapping, persistent crash evidence, one shot and rehearsed recovery required.

old_problem: Fatal target mapping, expected halt/reboot behavior and recovery were unspecified; raw HTTP/max-ID, plaintext transfer and log clearing could lose crash evidence. DeepSeek understated system-fatal behavior and omitted exact ext4 criteria.
disposition_reason: The exact command, single-shot method and fatal oracle are authoritative. ED-16 permits exact mapping, versions, isolated SUT, persistent evidence and recovery rehearsal as mandatory no-go runtime gates. Review resolution creates a complete gate-closed case; it does not authorize or execute the fatal injection.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2077, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2078 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00122-V003 / 06b4893bf8c989ff was directly read from XLSX and locked queue.
d0/b0/s4/t4/m1 plus OAM/UMC/ext4/AddressCommandParityErr/Uncorrected-system-fatal provide command and oracle; physical binding remains a signed prerequisite.
Loss of the in-band channel may be expected, so pre-crash evidence must persist independently and post-recovery OOB CPER is primary; availability is recorded, not fabricated.
Dedicated non-production SUT, independent console/power, explicit point approval and rehearsed recovery are mandatory before one execution.
Stop on behavior outside the signed fatal/recovery envelope; never retry or convert to persistent mode.
No injection, amdgpuras, Redfish/CPER, crash/reboot/power action, recovery, log clear, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Single-shot fatal UMC address/command parity injection with persistent CPER and recovery proof
test_case.purpose: Inject exactly one approved single-shot fatal UMC parity fault and prove the controlled fatal/recovery response plus OOB and surviving in-band CPER identify mapped OAM, UMC, ext4 AddressCommandParityErr and Uncorrected system-fatal severity.
required_package: Signed AMD/FAE mapping of d0/b0/s4/t4/m1 and expected fatal state sequence/event set
Compatible amdgpuras/firmware/driver/Redfish/cdump versions and ext4 schema
Dedicated non-production SUT, explicit one-shot approval, independent console/power and rehearsed recovery
Persistent pre-crash logging, authenticated paginated CPER access and secure storage
Signed boot/recovery deadline, final health oracle and quarantine policy
test_case.test_command: FATAL RAS GATE CLOSED. Preserve complete persistent baselines and prove console/power recovery. After just-in-time approval execute exactly once `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -s 4 -t 4 -m 1`; capture command and fatal console/power timeline without assuming SSH survives. Recover only through the signed path, enumerate all post CPER entries, securely hash/decode the causal attachment and reconcile available in-band -C. No clear, max-ID/plaintext shortcut, retry or persistent-mode substitution.
test_case.expected_result: The one approved single shot produces the signed fatal state sequence and recovery; causal CPER reports mapped OAM, UMC, ext4 AddressCommandParityErr and Uncorrected system-fatal severity, available in-band evidence is consistent, and final platform health meets the recovery oracle.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires signed mapping/envelope, one exact single shot, complete persistent crash/recovery timeline, verified CPER fields/cardinality and healthy final state. FAIL on wrong target/behavior, missing/extra event, decode mismatch, recovery failure or gap. Missing prerequisites is NOT READY.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until fatal mapping, isolated SUT, independent recovery and persistent evidence are signed and rehearsed.
One execution only with explicit point approval; expect loss of in-band access.
Preserve first-failure state; no clear, retry, mode substitution or unscripted power action.
Quarantine on behavior outside the approved fatal/recovery envelope.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and signed mapping/fatal/recovery contract
Tool/schema matrix, isolated authorization and persistent baselines
Exact command streams plus console/power/halt/reboot/recovery timeline
Paginated CPER manifests and secure raw/hash/decode
Final health, no-clear/no-retry audit, recovery/quarantine and verdict
test_case.recovery: On unexpected fatal behavior, missing console/control, wrong event or missed recovery deadline, stop and preserve evidence; do not inject or power-cycle again automatically. Use only the rehearsed signed recovery, quarantine uncertain SUT/GPU state and require AMD/platform-owner release.
